title: compartment-screen: registration, confirmatory results and exploratory analyses for a compartment screen on fly connectomes
description:
Pre-registration, frozen code, confirmatory results and later exploratory analyses for a compartment screen on the BANC connectome (release 888).

Registration: release v0.1.0-prereg, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24223802. Confirmatory results: release v0.2.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24224168. The registered analysis was run once, on 14 November 2026, and has not been rerun.

Added after the run, all exploratory and not registered: posthoc/, two analyses of why criteria C2 and C3 do not hold at a threshold of 5 synapses (part 1 since v0.2.1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24225600; part 2, measurement or biology, new in this version); and, new in this version, in exploratory/ a population-code row for the heading bump, with the points read from Fig. 4 of Seelig and Jayaraman (2015). The files in prereg/ and results/ are unchanged.
